title: Promotion cloning across Bonus Engine and CRM

gap in copy scope raised and blocked, rest ready

story.summary: Promotion manager clones an existing promotion
story.description:
As a promotion manager I want to clone a promotion so that I can reuse its reward set-up. Promotions can be linked to CRM campaigns that advertise them.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cloning a promotion creates a new promotion in Draft status with a new id.
- The clone copies the reward configuration, including all tiers, of the source promotion.
- The clone does not copy the start and end dates; both are empty in the clone.
- The clone is not linked to any CRM campaign of the source promotion.
- Cloning an archived promotion is allowed; cloning a deleted promotion is rejected.
